import collections
def objs(fr):
    out={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y':
            rws=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            if min(rws)<25: out['arch']=min(rws)
            else: out['U']=min(rws)
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>20:
            rws=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cls=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            if min(rws)>45: out['ball']=(min(rws),min(cls))
    return tuple(sorted(out.items()))
seen=collections.Counter()
for h in history:
    seen[objs(h.frame)]+=1
for k,v in seen.items(): print(k, v)
</parameter>
</function>
